spec2def(windowscodecsext.dll windowscodecsext.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# windowscodecsext.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/windowscodecsext-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(windowscodecsext_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(windowscodecsext_shims PRIVATE wine libole32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(windowscodecsext_shims)
add_cargo_module(windowscodecsext windowscodecsext-cargo windowscodecsext.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS windowscodecsext_shims psdk)
